# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VWAP_DIVERGENCE_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the opening price lies outside the 30-minute opening range while VWAP is on the opposite side of the range midpoint, the intraday auction tends to revert toward the value area. This edge exists because the initial imbalance (price outside range) contradicted by VWAP (intraday value) signals a likely false breakout that fades as liquidity seeks fair value.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: At the close of the first 5‑min bar, if (open > OR_high AND VWAP < OR_midpoint) OR (open < OR_low AND VWAP > OR_midpoint), enter short (for open above) or long (for open below). Exit: Chart‑stop at the opposite side of the opening range (OR_low for longs, OR_high for shorts). TP1 at 1R (risk = entry to stop). Runner: trail stop 10% off the high‑water mark after TP1. Time stop at 15:50 ET. Regime filter: only trades in low VIX (<15) and mid‑morning (09:45‑10:30) when OR is established.
